name: Floating Card
description: A solid colour card that drifts toward the pointer while its content drifts the other way, as if floating.

props.name: tone
props.description: The colour of the field. Every tone carries light text; the content sits in a dark theme scope so text-foreground reads light.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Classes for the coloured card: size, minimum height, grid placement.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the content inside the card. It is padded p-6, or p-8 from sm.

props.name: children
props.description: The card's content. Absolutely positioned children are placed against the card's edges.
